# Third-party distribution-license evidence

Only owner-supplied or otherwise authoritative license text may be stored here.
An approved entry in `config/distribution-license-policy-v1.json` must bind the
exact dependency revision, SPDX-compatible license expression, evidence path,
evidence SHA-256, reviewer, and review time.

The owner selected MIT for `campaign-muti-agent`. The authoritative text from
revision `1d935714449d18cad5bdc6711a498297ed73a5fb` is retained at
`campaign-muti-agent/LICENSE` and bound by SHA-256 in the distribution policy.
